threat_event: Ransomware spreads from IT into P8 plant OT through the dual-homed MES, the flat network, or the legacy domain trust and encrypts HMIs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat P8 network; dual-homed MES; legacy domain trust; no EDR or OT monitoring at P8
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-046, G-049)
existing_controls: Plant firewall at the internet edge; manual safe shutdown procedures
treatment_plan: OT DMZ and zoning at P8; remove dual-homing; EDR on P8 servers; OT sensors

threat_event: Ransomware or outage stops GEPS scheduling for all 8 plants beyond the MES buffer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: APS and integration hub recovery never tested; plants depend on one schedule release path
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-059, G-060)
existing_controls: MES holds about 48 hours of released orders; paper travelers at P1 to P7
treatment_plan: Full GEPS restore test; plant re-synchronization procedure; paper procedure at P8

threat_event: P8 MES and controller programs cannot be restored within the BIA time after an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: P8 MES backed up to local disk only; ad hoc controller copies; no paper procedure
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-041, G-059)
treatment_plan: Automated controller backups as at P1 to P7; MES backups to the vault; paper travelers

threat_event: Integration hub service account misuse writes altered work orders or bills of materials to the plants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hub accounts can write to all 8 plant MES; changes to released work orders not reviewed in the SIEM
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-035, G-053)
existing_controls: Routine tests catch many build errors before shipment
treatment_plan: Per-plant accounts; hub change logs to the SIEM; MES alerts on BOM changes after release

threat_event: Firmware signing key stolen from the build server and malicious TMU firmware signed and released
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Software keystore on a build server in the corporate domain
regulatory_driver: Utility addendum sec. 5 (CIP-013-2 R1.2.5 flow-down) (P03 G-095); CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-068)
treatment_plan: Hardware security module with split control; isolated build environment

threat_event: OEM always-on cellular routers at P8 used to reach drying ovens and winding machines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 routers always on with shared OEM logins and no MFA or logging
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-034, G-051)
treatment_plan: Disconnect routers; move OEMs to the central remote access gateway

threat_event: Unsupported HMIs at P8 exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 19 HMIs past vendor support; no patching process at P8
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-043, G-023)
treatment_plan: Replace or isolate the 19 HMIs; OEM-approved patch reviews

threat_event: Missed utility addenda duties (24 and 48 hour incident notices; 30-day vulnerability disclosure)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two disclosures late in 2026; incident notice steps not exercised
regulatory_driver: Utility addendum secs. 1 and 4 (CIP-013-2 R1.2.1, R1.2.4 flow-down) (P03 G-091, G-094)
treatment_plan: Disclosure workflow with 20-day internal target; notice drill in the 2026-12 tabletop

threat_event: A TMU firmware vulnerability is exploited at utility substations before disclosure or patch
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SBOMs for 3 of 7 firmware lines; disclosure late twice
regulatory_driver: Utility addendum sec. 4 (CIP-013-2 R1.2.4 flow-down) (P03 G-094)
treatment_plan: SBOMs for all lines; coordinated disclosure policy; fix timelines by severity

threat_event: FMS tenant isolation failure exposes one utility's asset data to another
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Multi-tenant database with application-level isolation
treatment_plan: Row-level security in the database

threat_event: FMS compromise used as a path into utility networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Design allows only utility-initiated one-way pushes
regulatory_driver: Utility addendum sec. 6 (CIP-013-2 R1.2.6 flow-down) (P03 G-096)
existing_controls: No inbound connections to utilities; mutual TLS
treatment_plan: Keep the one-way design as a release gate; annual architecture review with subscribers

threat_event: Demand forecast error misallocates storm-reserve production slots and spare units
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI-001 not independently validated; no written allocation rule; affiliate share not documented
treatment_plan: Validation, drift monitoring, and a written allocation rule (P10)
owner: VP supply chain and demand planning

threat_event: Predictive maintenance model misses a drying oven or vacuum system failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI-002 trained on 18 months of data from 5 plants
existing_controls: Preventive maintenance schedule stays in force; safety interlocks independent of AI
treatment_plan: Recall and false-alarm monitoring by equipment class (P10)

threat_event: P8 predictive maintenance connector exploited as an outbound path from OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor connector on the flat P8 network with direct internet access
treatment_plan: Move to a DMZ historian replica as at P1 to P7

threat_event: Designs pasted into unapproved public AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Approved assistant exists but public tools not blocked at all plants
treatment_plan: Block public AI sites on plant networks; training

threat_event: Theft of transformer designs from PLM by a competitor or nation-state
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PLM access broad within engineering; bulk export not alerted

threat_event: Test data altered or lost, so certified test reports are wrong
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: TDMS integrity checks limited to database backups
existing_controls: Quality review and signatures on every report
treatment_plan: Hash test results at the station; compare at release

threat_event: FCI exposed on broadly shared folders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: FCI labels applied to 9 of 14 contract folders
existing_controls: SYS-G1 MFA; restricted project sites for 9 contracts
treatment_plan: Label and restrict the other 5 folders

threat_event: Export screening bypassed during an outage
